values.note: Non-event nights $50 including fees and taxes for 30-amp + water, $55 for 50-amp; the site fee covers 4 people ($5 each per night for up to 4 more) and dogs are $5 each per night. Picnic table or fire pit rental $10 a stay each. Week-long stays (7+ days) 20% off, month-long (30+ days) 50% off. NASCAR, Formula SAE and Big Fam festival dates are sold separately.

values.note: Roughly 350 electric sites in the main campground, plus roughly 1,300 rustic sites in two fields near the speedway used on event weekends. Sites are not assigned by number: you choose a type (grassy, some shade, as much shade as possible); 'many sites can be treated as pull through sites' on non-event weekends. One RV plus one tent, or two tents, per site.

values.note: One shower building in the main campground (renovated 2023); two dump stations and a paid pump-out service. Sites have no picnic tables or fire pits (rentable for $10 a stay).

values.note: Regular (non-event) nights are booked on the operator's online reservation form (2026 season): pick dates, 30 or 50 amp, rig type and a site type; the form refuses one night ('OUR MINIMUM STAY IS 2 NIGHTS'). Passport America bookings have their own form (2-night minimum, 7-night maximum). Cancellations more than 30 days out are refunded less a $50 fee.

note: Large campground and event grounds on 200+ acres across US-12/Brooklyn Hwy from Michigan International Speedway (13500 US-12, Brooklyn): a main campground of ~350 electric sites in woods and open ground, plus ~1,300 rustic sites in two fields used on NASCAR and festival weekends. The operator calls it 'a predominantly seasonal and festival campground' but sells regular nights online; race and festival weekends are priced separately and very busy. Pin is on the main campground (OSM still names it Juniper Hills). Google 4.5 over 31 reviews. --Claude
summary: Operator's reservations, Passport America, seasonal-FAQ and maps pages + its 2026 online reservation form: minimum is still 2 nights on every non-event stay ('2 NIGHT MINIMUM RESERVATION', the form refuses one night), NOT 3+, so it stays under AWH's rule (event dates are separate). $50 incl. taxes/fees for 30-amp + water, $55 for 50-amp (confirmed, 2026); 50-amp, water (confirmed), no sewer; ~350 electric sites; showers, two dump stations; season roughly May 1 - Oct 31 (new); Passport America $25 (new). Price gate: $50 all-in, at the line, not over; no gateway within 40 km (Detroit 104 km); family has not stayed. Long-stay tests: (1) $50 pass; (2) nightly rate on its own site + phone 517-858-9218 + online booking form, no application (the seasonal FAQ's RV-age/photo check is for seasonals); (3) 2-night minimum, pass; (4) no seasonal/nightly count posted (pass), and the form says non-event weekends are 'not typically very busy'; (5) not a home community. No RV Life rating; Good Sam false (directory) left. Note trimmed of rates, minimum line and season.
flags: Long-stay character (for AWH): the operator's own reservation form says 'AS A PREDOMINANTLY SEASONAL AND FESTIVAL CAMPGROUND, OUT SITES DO NOT HAVE PICNIC TABLES OR FIREPITS'. It passes the five tests on the pages read (nightly $50 sold online, 2-night minimum, no site counts split seasonal vs nightly), but no count of seasonal sites is posted.
Standing 2-night minimum on every non-event stay (kept under AWH's 2026-10-10 rule; recorded in booking.min_stay). Quote: 'RESERVATION GUIDELINES ... 2 NIGHT MINIMUM RESERVATION.'

RV age: the seasonal FAQ says 'In general, RVs that are less than 15 years old are acceptable ... We will request to see recent exterior photos of any RV over 10 years old.' Stated for seasonal camping; EKKO (2023) passes either way.
Price gate: $50 a night all-in (taxes and fees included) for the cheapest RV site, exactly at the US$50 line; no gateway within 40 km.
